notes: The italicized of him has no Greek preposition to answer to and rides with the verb under rules 7 and 36.
εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα is written out as for ever, so the ordinary rule 30 analysis applies and only the article is empty; rule 48's never is not this case.
ὅτι is recitative and unrepresented under rule 43, the ASV marking the quotation by punctuation.
